status: Fixed before any 2025-11-28 test outcome was loaded or viewed. Feature groups and candidate chosen from validation dates of the five earlier protocols only.
source_selection: Dates never used in the project; archive ends 2025-12-05. Shard index = int(sha256(f'{date}|homie-activity-fresh'), 16) mod the date's file count, computed from file counts only. Row group 0.
primary: First-appearance AP: homie_all (writable history + activity + declared-fee features) versus homie (current writable-context model), 500 paired one-hour block bootstrap draws.
pass_rule: Positive AP gain with the 95% interval entirely above zero.
secondary: homie_activity versus homie on both groups.
homie_fee versus homie on both groups.
Concentration check: gain recomputed without the fee payer with the most failures in each group.
reporting: Retain and report results regardless of direction. Single run; the script refuses to overwrite.
limitations: Fresh dates fall between earlier study periods, not after them.
Activity and fee context come from the sampled archive, not the full chain.
Declared fee is recovered from the charged fee; base fee assumed 5,000 lamports per signer.
Not identity-controlled; compare with the report's identity-controlled results only qualitatively.
